description: During sign-up, call it first with the level only, then with leaders (suggest_leader proposes one). Leaders to copy (followed in order: up to 3 at prudent, equilibre and risque, up to 5 at advanced; the others stay saved) and the exposure level. Every level copies your leaders' positions scaled to your balance, adds and reductions included, with their stop loss and take profit and no stop of its own; the size is set per leader, so following fewer leaders lowers your exposure. prudent: 25% of your leaders' size across 3 leaders, total exposure up to 3x your balance, drawdown alerts at -6% and -8%. equilibre: 50%, up to 10x, alerts -15% and -20%. risque: 100%, up to 20x, alerts -30% and -50%, 2 leaders strongly recommended (not required), risk_ack: true required above 10,000 USDC. advanced: every plan and the free trial, starts with risque's settings; change them with set_advanced. Alerts never close anything on their own. At prudent, equilibre and risque, new copies need a Hyperliquid Unified Account (switch_to_unified_account) with no positions opened outside WakeTrades; at advanced, only the xyz markets need it. An account needs a minimum balance because Hyperliquid has a minimum order size: plan for at least 1,100 USDC at prudent, 550 at equilibre, 300 at risque (get_levels gives recommendedLevel for your balance); below that, most copies open at the 11 USDC minimum order, larger than the level's share; the answer may carry a non-blocking warning copies_too_small.
